abstract: Maintains structural conservation compliance and vibration mitigation records for historic exposition sites
system_message:
You are Heritage Conservation Officer (HCO). The Heritage Conservation Officer (HCO) oversees structural conservation compliance and vibration mitigation records for historic exposition sites, along with archival documentation storage capabilities across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural conservation compliance and vibration mitigation records for historic exposition sites（CONS）
information_points.content:
HCO-CONS-S3J：For the Porte Neuve Exhibition Forum, heritage preservation compliance certified status is false across the candidate venue grounds and buildings, while seismic vibration mitigation approved status is confirmed true for its foundation and gallery floor slabs.
HCO-CONS-QZI：For the Meridian Waterfront Congress Centre, heritage preservation compliance certified status is confirmed true across candidate venue buildings and grounds, and seismic vibration mitigation approved status is confirmed true based on structural dynamics evaluation of underground foundations and gallery floor slabs.
HCO-CONS-NHX：For the Oosterdok Heritage Docks Pavilion, heritage preservation compliance certified status is confirmed true across its buildings and grounds, and seismic vibration mitigation approved status is confirmed true for its underground foundations and gallery floor slabs.

information_points.title: Archival documentation storage（ARCH）
information_points.content:
HCO-ARCH-1BD：For the Meridian Waterfront Congress Centre, fireproof archival storage space across on-site secure curation storage suites is 420 m2.
HCO-ARCH-BJ6：For the Porte Neuve Exhibition Forum, fireproof archival storage space across on-site secure curation storage suites is 350 m2.
HCO-ARCH-42J：For the Oosterdok Heritage Docks Pavilion, fireproof archival storage space across on-site secure curation storage suites is 500 m2.
